title: viola betonicifolia subsp. napaulensis
intro: Viola betonicifolia subsp. napaulensis, commonly known as the Himalayan or Himalayan pansy, is a plant species belonging to the family Violaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola betonicifolia subsp. napaulensis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
